اقشعرا (form IVq)
# اِقْشَعَرَّا (iqšaʕarrā) /iq.ʃa.ʕar.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# اِقْشَعِرَّا (iqšaʕirrā) /iq.ʃa.ʕir.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
